About TidyFigure

TidyFigure is a collection of free online tools for the small jobs that come up every day: shrinking a photo for an email, merging two PDFs, counting the words in an essay, making a QR code, or working out a percentage.

Every tool runs entirely in your web browser. When you compress an image or merge a PDF, the file is processed on your own device and is never uploaded to a server. That makes the tools faster and keeps your files private.

Accuracy

Calculator pages explain the formula they use and show a worked example, so you can check the result yourself. For legal, medical or financial decisions, please check with a qualified professional.
